change.rationale: Students turned away from a full course should hear about it (they may pick another course); a repeat request stays quiet because the student already holds the seat. Integrated by agent:coder from the owner's UI handoff and its own draft; labels aligned so no name or description still says a full-course rejection is not announced.

request.behavior: enroll() keeps recording every decision. A confirmed enrollment still sends one enrollment-confirmed notification. A rejection because the course is full now also sends exactly one enrollment-rejected notification to that student, with the message '<course> is full; your enrollment was not accepted.'. A repeat request (ALREADY_ENROLLED) sends none. The HTTP API and the web page are unchanged; the page already lists whatever notifications the API returns.
acceptanceCriteria: A COURSE_FULL rejection produces exactly one enrollment-rejected notification for that enrollment
A confirmed enrollment still produces exactly one enrollment-confirmed notification
An ALREADY_ENROLLED rejection produces no notification and takes no seat
GET /api/notifications returns the rejected student's enrollment-rejected entry
